description: Returns the smallest finite number in the list. Non-number values are ignored, an empty or number-free list returns 0, and non-finite numbers fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: values_list
inputs.description: Numbers to inspect in order. Non-number values are ignored. An absent list uses an empty list.

outputs.name: min
outputs.description: Returns the smallest finite number, or 0 when no number is present.

description: Returns the largest finite number in the list. Non-number values are ignored, an empty or number-free list returns 0, and non-finite numbers fail before a result is published.

inputs.name: values_list
inputs.description: Numbers to inspect in order. Non-number values are ignored. An absent list uses an empty list.

outputs.name: max
outputs.description: Returns the largest finite number, or 0 when no number is present.
